title: On the coefficients of the Taylor expansion of $L$-functions of elliptic curves
summary: In this paper, we investigate the coefficients of the Taylor expansion of the complex $L$-series of any elliptic curve over $\mathbb{Q}$. We prove that, in the family of quadratic twists by all the discriminants $d$, these coefficients are nonvanishing under GRH when $d$ is sufficiently large. Unconditionally, we obtain a general lower bound for the number of nonvanishing coefficients in the family of quadratic twists, through a series of results from the moments of the central values of the derivatives of quadratic twists of modular $L$-function.
